Name: Robin Upgrades Greenhouse
Author: TheWariorGW
Description:
[size=3][b]How It Works[/b]

[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Visit Robin's Carpenter Shop.[/size]
[*][size=3]Choose the Greenhouse upgrade.[/size]
[*][size=3]Wait for the construction to finish.[/size]
[*][size=3]Enjoy your upgraded Greenhouse![/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Features[/b]

Default Greenhouse - Symmetrical design 11x11 - Replaces the original Greenhouse map.
First Greenhouse Upgrade - Symmetrical design 15x15 - Materials:
[list]
[*][size=3]200000 Gold[/size]
[*][size=3]200 Clay[/size]
[*][size=3]50 Iron Bar[/size]
[*][size=3]20 Hardwood[/size]
[/list][size=3]Second Greenhouse Upgrade - Symmetrical design 21x21 - Materials
[list]
[*][size=3][size=3]500000 Gold[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]500 Clay[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]100 Gold Bar[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]50 Iridium Bar[/size][/size]
[/list]
If you install this mod mid-playthrough some crops will not be in their area because of the modification to the default Greenhouse map.
When you upgrade the Greenhouse, all the crops will remain in their area, also, some trees will be in the crop area, you will need to move them manually.
[/size][/size][size=3]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[/size][size=3]
It is not compatible with other mods that load the map of the Greenhouse.
If you are playing in multiplayer, all players must have this mod installed.

[b]Install[/b]

Install SMAPI
Install Content Patcher
Download and unzip the mod into your [i]Mods[/i] folder

[b]Configuration[/b]

Provides configuration to customize the difficulty according to you. You can:
[list]
[*][size=3]Adjust the number of days each upgrade takes.[/size]
[*][size=3]Modify all required building materials to suit your playstyle.[/size]
[/list]
[b]Future plans[/b]

[list]
[*][size=3]Bug fixes[/size]
[/list]
Additionally, I'm thinking about including these features in future updates:

[list]
[*][size=3]Blueprint Difficulty System Mechanic: Introduce a progressive system where obtaining the Greenhouse upgrade blueprints becomes more challenging, adding a new layer of gameplay strategy.[/size]
[*][size=3]Map Enhancements: Expand the Greenhouse map even further, providing additional space for crops and trees.[/size]
[*][size=3]More Upgrade Levels: Add new stages of upgrades to make the Greenhouse even more functional and visually appealing.[/size]
[*][size=3]Additional Benefits: Incorporate unique mechanics, like auto irrigation, after fully upgraded Greenhouses.[/size]
[/list]
I’m open to your ideas and suggestions.
[/size]

Downloads.Description:
Added automatic tree mover after the greenhouse is upgraded.
Updated the resource config to include more types of materials.
